doc.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His sister's schooling and the move to New York
summary: His sister attended Hunter and Columbia; the family moved to New York around 1924.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You mentioned your sister going to Columbia.
Uh, she … you're right that she did go to Hunter College. She got her Bachelor's from Hunter College but she got her Master's Degree from Columbia University. That's where it was. Thank you, Billie.

Oh God. What year was that? …. That was … well now let's see, we moved to New York when I would say, around 1924 and she would have had to have been at least a year in high school because she was only 14 years old when she graduated from high school in North Carolina and she was too young to be matriculated in a college, they thought at that time and so she spent a year in a high school, a few years in a high school, I think Julia Richmond High School, and then she went to Hunter College. So that puts it '25 … 4 years, '29 … I suspect she graduated from Hunter around 1930 and probably from Columbia University probably the next year, '31 or something like that, and then went into teaching.
